pattern.description: After a hard cut from the headline to an empty light canvas, a horizontal row of five app logos (Notion, Slack, Docs, Slides, Sheets) rises into place from below, staggered left to right.
pattern.why_premium: A short left-to-right stagger turns a flat logo row into a readable sequence, and every icon lands on the same baseline with a soft ease-out, so the 'one tool replaces many' idea reads in under a second.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.app-logo', {y: 80, opacity: 0}, {y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.06}) after a hard cut to the empty canvas; order left to right.
build_hint.remotion: For each logo i: const p = spring({frame: frame - i * 2, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); translateY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [80, 0]); opacity = interpolate(p, [0, 0.4], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}).

notes: Energy spike at frame 219 is the hard cut from the 'One AI tool to do it all.' headline; the logo rise follows. b01 (union), b04 (OCR misread) and b08 (empty motion trail beside Slides) are not separate elements. Fade component is inferred; logos may simply slide in from below the frame crop.
